PSP.name: PPSSPP WebAssembly
PSP.reason: The upstream project requires its PPSSPP-WASM submodule and a built release bundle. The Playerun repository does not yet contain those generated runtime assets.

SEGA.name: JGenesis WebAssembly
SEGA.reason: The upstream project has a dedicated web frontend and WASM build, but its compiled web distribution must be built and vendored before it can run offline inside Playerun.
